dli-39-7680-2.summary: A friend of General Reyes, then governor of Nuevo León, warns him in July 1909 that the President speaks of him as an enemy and urges him not to declare himself at once, to keep calm and be prudent and to look after his health; other clubs of Guadalajara will write; he sends a pleading message the same day; the one complaint is quejándose (tentative).

dli-39-7712-1.summary: A short note of 29 July: there is a rupture between Limantour and (probably) Creel; the typed line asks Reyes to put his worries aside and read the reply carefully.

dli-39-7677-7696.summary: Short telegrams: the President is a declared enemy and postpones an explanation; Dr. Gómez must go; graves matters; clubs to be told to hold their replies.

system: A numerical substitution (code numbers to letters) proposed by the contributor: 28 independently supported number-to-letter values and one provisional value (60 = Y). Not examined by the project.
